cases.seen: Product info offers free shipping over $15; footer claims free shipping over $150 in North America
cases.risk: Unscoped policy copy can contradict buyer's market and product-level trust text
cases.vsn_guard: Single market/currency-specific policy source; resolve precedence and show eligibility accurately

cases.seen: Variant table with per-unit price, quantity-rule links, sold out lines, zero extended totals in static HTML
cases.risk: Merchant may misinterpret demo markup as activated wholesale entitlements or a functional B2B order flow
cases.vsn_guard: Require plan-aware native eligibility, tested quantity rules and meaningful empty totals; never claim Shopify Plus verified

cases.seen: PDP source contains Sold out and Add to cart in same fetched document plus multiple flavor options
cases.risk: HTML-only reading could falsely classify hidden alternate states as an actual UX defect
cases.vsn_guard: Render selected variant availability consistently; test actual variant changes before claiming malfunction

cases.seen: Serum product copy describes retinol strength, skin benefit and safety/ingredient marketing
cases.risk: Demo medical/cosmetic copy might be transferred without independently verified merchant evidence
cases.vsn_guard: Merchant-owned metafields, claim review workflow and optional evidence/reference, not fixed theme claims

cases.seen: Artist authenticity, original artwork and preservation/framing statements in PDP copy
cases.risk: Artwork provenance and valuation cannot be inferred from demonstration text
cases.vsn_guard: Structured optional authenticity fields with merchant verification and empty-state controls
